nf022ca76cb.summary: The Development Bank of Kazakhstan increased its loan portfolio more than fourfold to 1.7 trillion tenge over five years, with 77% of loans supporting manufacturing projects.
nf022ca76cb.why: The bank's growth and focus on manufacturing projects indicate Kazakhstan's economic development priorities and investment climate.
